title: Add slugify and a CLI for it
body: Add lib/slug.js exporting slugify(s): lowercase, every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes one '-', no leading or trailing '-' ('Hello, World!' -> 'hello-world'). Export it from index.js as slugify next to the existing exports. Make cli.js print slugify(process.argv[2]). Do not edit test.js. Then COMMIT: `git add lib/slug.js index.js cli.js && git commit -m "add slugify"` (uncommitted files are not delivered: the check reads the committed branch).
